entities.summary: Sverre Kjelsberg (b. 1946-10-18, Tromsø Municipality) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Tromsø Municipality and Norway. Known in the fields of norway, composers & musicians, europe.
